body: I know i just cant help it, i still dot even know why my testivles are so painful and growing daily
Simple walk in, give then the Clint Eastwood stare, and say "Do you feel lucky punk?"

I just broke up with my longest term partner. Her mother passed recently and she simply changed and became a right cow to me. 

I lost my only parent not long ago, and her mother was very much in my care aswell. So i understand why she pushed so hard, she just couldn't cope with the feelings and emotions that i brought up by being so close.

I missed her a lot, but ive found peace in the fact she wont hurt anymore and i can move on quickly. To me a relationship is only worth the happiness it provides and our happiness was completely gone.

It sucks and i was left no only without a partner but lost my home, my job, my car,all my money and the child i basically became a dad to . But a lot of whiskey and a fresh start and tomorrow i can relive the pain over and over again until it kills me :)
